guitars.name: MT-COT
guitars.subtitle: Crown of Thorns — Marko Tervonen Signature
guitars.description: The signature model of Marko Tervonen of Swedish metal band The Crown, built on the 8141 P Classic platform. A gradient finish fades from transparent white across the body to near-black at the headstock, with hand-finished artwork referencing The Crown's 2024 album 'Crown of Thorns' — the band name carried in the rear and fretboard inlays.

specs.label: Neck
specs.value: Maple with 3-ply Mahogany / Maple / Mahogany laminate, Ultraflow set-neck

specs.label: Extras
specs.value: Dual-LED battery indicator in volume knob, kill switch

passport.woodOrigin: Ash and ebony selected by hand in Heino, Salland

diary.title: Raw body
diary.caption: The mahogany body blank, freshly cut and ready to be shaped by hand.

diary.title: Carved top
diary.caption: The body top carved and contoured — where the platform for the Crown of Thorns begins.

diary.title: Fretting
diary.caption: Frets pressed into the ebony fingerboard, one at a time.

diary.title: Fret dressing
diary.caption: Every fret end rounded, levelled and polished by hand for a fast, smooth feel.

diary.title: Inlays
diary.caption: Inlay work set into the board — the small details that make it unmistakably Schotman.

diary.title: Neck & headstock
diary.caption: The neck carved and the headstock shaped, ready to carry the Schotman name.

diary.title: Neck complete
diary.caption: Fingerboard, frets and neck finished and checked.

diary.title: In the paint booth
diary.caption: Into Robert's own booth — where the finish and hand artwork are sprayed.

diary.title: Custom paint
diary.caption: The gradient finish and Crown of Thorns artwork, applied by hand.

diary.title: Completed
diary.caption: Assembled, wired and set up — one of one, ready to play.

guitars.name: 8141 S Green
guitars.subtitle: Salland Series · Marble Green
guitars.description: A 'marble green' superstrat with exotic wood combinations chosen to match the guitar's voice to its looks. Spalted maple top and headstock faceplate over a flamed maple laminate — no two are ever alike.

specs.label: Body
specs.value: Mahogany / yellow poplar with flamed maple laminate

specs.label: Top
specs.value: Spalted maple top layer & headstock faceplate

specs.label: Electronics
specs.value: Alpha 500K push-pull pots, Schotman toggle switch

specs.label: Hardware
specs.value: Schaller stop tail & STM bridge (chrome), Ratio locking tuners, Schaller S-locks

guitars.name: 8141 S Transparant
guitars.subtitle: Salland Series · Natural Transparent
guitars.description: Inspired by the classic Stratocaster but reworked for balance, weight and access to all 24 frets. A transparent finish over a 5mm spalted maple top lets the hand-selected grain speak, with a regional bog oak fingerboard grounding the sound.

specs.label: Neck
specs.value: 9-layer Maple / Bubinga / Blackwood, carbon-fibre rods + dual-action truss

specs.label: Hardware
specs.value: Schaller stop tail & STM bridge, M6 locking tuners, Graphtech nut, S-locks

guitars.name: 8141 S Black
guitars.subtitle: Salland Series · Black Gloss
guitars.description: Stealth. A Stratocaster-inspired superstrat in black gloss with a fast, flat modern-C neck, 13° headstock and a 24-fret cutaway for full access. Railhammer pickups drive the tone — all attitude, no distraction.

specs.label: Body
specs.value: Yellow poplar with 3-ply maple laminate, black gloss

specs.label: Neck
specs.value: Ultraflow set-neck, flattened modern C, carbon-fibre rods

specs.label: Hardware
specs.value: Schaller STM bridge (black) & stop tail, Ratio tuners (chrome/black), Schaller S-locks

guitars.name: 8141 P Classic
guitars.subtitle: Salland Series · Classic
guitars.description: The classic take on the 8141 line — a mahogany body with a quilted maple top, advanced set-neck construction and a contoured cutaway for easy upper-body access. Timeless shape, modern build, unmistakably handmade in Heino.

specs.label: Electronics
specs.value: Dual Alpha 500K push-pull pots, toggle switch, stereo output

specs.label: Hardware
specs.value: Schaller bridge & tailpiece (nickel), M6 locking tuners, S-locks
